**Newsroom brief: BEA's August 26 Calendar Puts Two Releases at 8:30 AM**

BEA has two releases scheduled for August 26 at 8:30 AM: second-quarter GDP and corporate profits, plus July personal income and outlays.

**Context:** It also schedules Personal Income and Outlays, July 2026, for August 26 at 8:30 AM.

Source-bound brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication
